title: Log in to Paragon
description: Choose which account you want to use. Then you'll link your PlayStation or Steam profiles to sync your trophies and achievements.
disclaimer: We don't store passwords: your provider handles access. Trophies are read from your public PSN profile, so your trophy privacy must be visible.
